class.name: OverworldCharacterNode
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A complete character system for overworld scenes that handles movement, animations, dialogue, and interactions.
class.description:
[OverworldCharacterNode] is a comprehensive character controller for overworld scenes in UT-Godot-Engine. It combines movement, animation, dialogue, and interaction systems to create fully functional NPCs or controllable characters.
[b]Core Systems[/b] • [b]Movement System[/b]: Directional movement with automatic animation switching between idle and walking states • [b]Animation Management[/b]: Automatic handling of directional animations (up, down, side) and sprite flipping • [b]Dialogue System[/b]: Integration with [DialogueAsset] and [TextBox] for character conversations • [b]Interaction System[/b]: Uses [InteractionTrigger] to detect player interactions • [b]Alert System[/b]: Visual alerts with sound effects for encounters or interactions
[b]Required Components[/b] • [OverworldSprite] - The animated sprite component • [InteractionTrigger] - Area2D for detecting interactions • [DialogueAsset] - Resource containing character dialogue
[b]Animation States[/b] The character automatically switches between idle and movement animations based on velocity: • Idle: "idle_down", "idle_side", "idle_up" • Moving: "move_down", "move_side", "move_up" • Special: "act" animation for custom actions
[b]Usage Example[/b] [codeblock] extends OverworldCharacterNode
func _ready(): # Set up character properties character = "Sans" walk_speed = 80
# Load dialogue dialogues = preload("res://Game/dialogues/sans_dialogue.tres") current_index = 0
# Start walking in a direction start_walking(Vector2i(1, 0)) # Move right
# Show alert for 1 second show_alert(1.0) [/codeblock]
[b]Automatic Setup[/b] The character automatically loads required nodes from "res://Engine/RequiredNode/overworld_character_node.tscn" including alert sprites and encounter sound effects.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: start_walking
method.description: Starts or stops character movement in the specified direction. If [param direction] is non-zero, the character begins moving and switches to movement animations. If [param direction] is zero, the character stops moving and switches to idle animations. Automatically handles animation state changes and sprite flipping.

method.name: force_direction
method.description: Forces the character to face a specific direction without moving. Updates animation state and sprite orientation based on the normalized direction vector. Useful for making characters face the player or specific objects.

method.name: show_alert
method.description: Displays an alert indicator above the character for the specified duration. Plays the encounter sound effect and shows the alert sprite using [member frame_alert]. The alert automatically hides after the duration expires. Commonly used for encounter notifications or attention-grabbing effects.

method.name: set_frame
method.description: Sets the character sprite to display a specific frame from the "act" animation. Useful for displaying custom poses or expressions outside of normal animation cycles.

method.name: play_anim
method.description: Plays a specific animation with optional speed and direction control. Connects to the animation_finished signal and emits [signal animation_finished] when complete. [param key] is the animation name, [param speed] controls playback speed, and [param from_end] plays from the last frame.

members.member: The character's name used for dialogue display. This name appears in dialogue boxes when the character speaks.
The character's movement speed in pixels per second. Range: 0-400. Higher values make the character move faster.
The frame index to display when showing alerts. References a frame in the alert sprite's animation sequence.

Reference to the [OverworldSprite] component that handles character visuals. Must be set for the character to display and animate properly. The sprite automatically switches between idle and movement animations.

Reference to the [InteractionTrigger] component that detects player interactions. Must be set for the character to respond to player interactions. When triggered, initiates dialogue using the current dialogue asset.

The current dialogue index to use when interacting with this character. References an index in the [member dialogues] asset's dialogue array. Can be changed to progress through different conversation states.
The [DialogueAsset] resource containing this character's dialogue data. Used to display conversation text when the player interacts with the character. Automatically loads localized data when set.

signal.name: character_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the character's dialogue interaction is completed. Triggered after a dialogue sequence initiated by player interaction finishes.

signal.name: animation_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a custom animation played via [method play_anim] completes. Useful for chaining animations or triggering events after specific animations.
